headline: The vale's boar got teeth — and the juice layer woke up
lede: EMBERWOOD's tuskroot and cinder pod were first-pass blobs with a hidden skeleton key bug: the renderer's particle layer existed but the shell never called it. This stage repainted both monsters, gave the charge a dust trail and the pod a split-pop, and rewired the whole juice pipeline.

notes.text: Tuskroot repainted as a 16x16 log-boar: bark grain, knot, mossy mane, root-feet gait, curved two-tone tusks; eyes go amber to white to red across walk, telegraph, charge. Pod is now a husked seed with a pulsing ember vein.
Charge-dust is deterministic: the sim emits a puff every 6th moving charge frame behind the heels, opposite the locked line — proof-route hash untouched (win still lands at tick 11233).

Found dead code that mattered: render.js exported onFx, index.jsx never called it — no particles had ever rendered on the live page. Fixed, plus 7 new gates (142/142) and a mutant that proves the dust gates bite.
